paper.title_en: Classical soft theorems meet the post-Newtonian expansion
paper.abstract_en: Classical soft theorems govern the non-analytic structure of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation in the low-frequency regime, with the gravitational memory effect providing the canonical realization of the classical soft graviton theorem. While the soft behavior of radiation from hyperbolic scattering is well understood, its realization in gravitationally bound systems remains less explored. In this work, we study the soft structure of gravitational waveforms generated by compact binaries, focusing on the scattering of emitted radiation off the static background curvature within the multipolar post-Newtonian framework. We isolate the infrared (IR) logarithms associated with hereditary effects, including the tail-of-memory, and their higher generalizations with n-tail insertions. The resulting amplitudes exhibit a Laurent expansion in frequency space consistent with the Sahoo-Sen logarithmic soft theorems, thereby establishing a direct correspondence between gravitational memory effects, their higher-order tail corrections, and the soft expansion. We also comment on ultraviolet (UV) logarithms arising from short-distance sensitivity of the multipole expansion and their associated renormalization-group running.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将经典软定理与后牛顿展开相结合，研究紧致双星引力波形的红外对数结构（包括记忆的尾项效应）与Sahoo-Sen对数软定理的对应关系，属于广义相对论基础与引力波理论交叉的硬核理论工作，理论深度较高，具有可点击阅读的价值。
decision.title_zh: 经典软定理与后牛顿展开的交汇
decision.abstract_zh: 经典软定理支配着低频区电磁辐射与引力辐射的非解析结构，而引力记忆效应则提供了经典软引力定理的典型实现。虽然双曲散射辐射的软行为已被很好地理解，但其在引力束缚系统中的实现仍较少被探索。在本工作中，我们研究由紧致双星产生的引力波形的软结构，重点是在多极后牛顿框架内，发射出的辐射如何被静态背景曲率散射。我们分离出与遗传感效应相关的红外（IR）对数，包括记忆的尾项及其带有 n 个尾插入的高阶推广。由此得到的振幅在频率空间中呈现洛朗展开，与 Sahoo-Sen 对数软定理一致，从而在引力记忆效应、其高阶尾修正与软展开之间建立起直接的对应关系。我们还评论了由多极展开的短距离敏感性产生的紫外（UV）对数及其相关的重整化群跑动。
